summary.text: Claire Heinrich is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 110 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Niles Stephens.

Heinrich is a Washington University graduate and former software engineer who, in a Ballotpedia survey, says she works at a local nonprofit and lists public schools, infrastructure and health care among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Claire Heinrich graduated from Washington High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Washington University in St. Louis in 2020.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Heinrich said she was born and raised in Washington, Missouri, attended Missouri public schools, and graduated from Washington University with a degree in computer science.

She said she worked as a software engineer in marketing and later in the aerospace industry, is completing an MBA in Nonprofit and Public Management, and works at a local nonprofit helping middle and high school students build public speaking and problem-solving skills.
Heinrich said she volunteers with a local food pantry and lives in Wildwood.

Heinrich's stated priorities in the survey include protecting public schools and opposing state money for private school vouchers, securing infrastructure funding for District 110, and supporting affordable, quality health care.
